name: Husqvarna 450 / 450e
blurb: 13″–20″ bars on .325″ chain, .050″ gauge, 56–80 drive links, from Husqvarna's 2027 bar and chain fit-up guide.
intro: These rows are the homeowner 450 / 450e in the fit-up guide. The 450 Rancher is a different entry, with its own page. Husqvarna's Bar & Chain Fit-up Guide (cover year 2027) lists 4 bar and chain combinations for the 450 / 450e: 13″, 16″, 18″, 20″. Pitch on those rows: .325″. Gauge: .050″. Match pitch, gauge and drive links to the bar-tail stamp before you order.

bars.note: Husqvarna's 2027 fit-up guide pairs this 13″ setup with bar X-Force 596199756 and chain SP33G X-Cut 581643656.
Husqvarna's 2027 fit-up guide pairs this 16″ setup with bar X-Force 596199766 and chain SP33G X-Cut 581643666.
Husqvarna's 2027 fit-up guide pairs this 18″ setup with bar X-Force 596199772 and chain SP33G X-Cut 581643672.
Husqvarna's 2027 fit-up guide pairs this 20″ setup with bar X-Force 596199780 and chain SP33G X-Cut 581643680.

sources.title: Bar & Chain Fit-up Guide (cover year 2027): certified/approved bar and chain combinations, with bar length, pitch, gauge, drive links, file size, bar part and chain part

sources_note: Husqvarna Bar & Chain Fit-up Guide, cover dated 2027, PDF read 5 Nov 2026 (https://media.husqvarnagroup.com/original/DI-328359.pdf). Every row restates that saw's entry in the guide.
